name: tillgraph
description: Find and compare local service businesses in Cambridge and Boston, MA: what they offer, what they charge, when they're open and how to book.

interface.longDescription: TillGraph helps you find a local service business in Cambridge or Boston, Massachusetts. Ask for what you need, such as a barber in Harvard Square, a dentist taking new patients or a plumber who can come today, and it returns matching independent businesses with their services, published prices, opening hours, and their booking link or phone number. It covers salons and barbers, nails and spas, dentists, chiropractors and eye care, gyms and studios, auto and bike repair, home services, pet care, dry cleaners and tailors, lessons and more. Listings marked as verified were confirmed by the business owner. TillGraph is a read-only directory: it does not make bookings, take payments or need an account.
